summary: Repair #4 (biometric auth gate on manual Backup/Restore) verified end-to-end via live UI + WebAuthn stub. critical_code_review_comments: Repair #4 code is clean: try/finally in handleRestore correctly resets e.target.value on ALL paths including auth-fail and JSON parse error. Auth-gate matches handleClearAllData pattern exactly. Toggle-OFF path is truly untouched — the guard `if (toggles.requireAuthExport && method === 'biometric')` short-circuits cleanly.
Non-blocking (pre-existing): SettingsModal file input value binding produces a React controlled/uncontrolled warning in console. Not caused by Repair #4.
seed_data_creation: Test used inline WebAuthn stub (navigator.credentials.get) + direct IDB seeding of sec_method/sec_toggles/sec_webauthn_cred_id on the singleton settings row. One TEST_ note ('test-restore-1') was written during GATE 6.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AUTH-GATE entry points in the DOM: [data-testid=backup-btn] and [data-testid=restore-input] inside SettingsModal (NOT the BackupRestoreModal — that has its own separate handleExport/handleFilePick which do NOT go through NotesApp.handleBackup/handleRestore and are OUT OF SCOPE for Repair #4). To mock biometrics on the web PWA: stub navigator.credentials.get() and seed sec_method='biometric' + sec_toggles JSON + sec_webauthn_cred_id in IDB settings store via cursor.update() (out-of-line keys).
